name: Herbot
author: ozz1ee
description: Your Hermes Bot Mode roster in the bar: every bot drawn as its own avatar, the newest thing it said, and one click - or one line of typing - to reach it.

barWidget.description: Bots that are active or waiting on you appear in the bar as their own avatars - the shape and colour they have in Hermes - and the panel lists every bot with its newest message, an input that sends to the selected bot, and one click to open it.

schema.label: What sits beside the mark
schema.description: avatars = the bots that are active or waiting on you, drawn as themselves, with the waiting count beside them; count = just how many are waiting; none = the mark alone.

schema.label: Panel order
schema.description: attention = bots that want you first, longest wait at the top, then a rule and everyone else by recency; gateway = grouped by what the gateway serves and what it does not; flat = purely by recency. The g key cycles it and the choice is saved.

schema.label: Most avatars to show in the bar
Notify when a bot writes or waits for you
schema.description: Hermes' own desktop notifications are left to Hermes. This is the watcher raising an Omarchy card when a bot's newest message is not yours, with a click that opens that bot. Only transitions are announced, at most one card per bot.
